detail: No case shows an admin can still call the v1 update (UpdateItemV1 also got RequireAuthorization); add a happy-path admin PUT api-version=1.0 expecting success and persisted change.

AC requires the fixme marker removed from ordering-api.spec.ts, that test passing, and the rest of the file passing. The plan declares this out of scope and has no case running that command; add a case that runs the spec command and asserts all tests pass with no fixme.

AC requires the matching row removed from the bugs table in testing/flows/. No case verifies this, and the story has no Test scope excluding it; add a verification case or have the story author mark it out of scope.
